notes.title: MegaFix Patch
notes.content: We have fixed a lot of issues that have been reported by our players. Namely, single player disconnects in the menu, which was happening due to a silly little guy we named Frederick. That bug has been sent on his way, and we're back in business.

notes.title: QuickFix Patch
notes.content: Quick fix to resolve the issue where the keyboard mapping image was blocking the settings

notes.title: Day 0 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your patience! We have been hard at work since launch to fix some bugs identified by our players. Below are the following changes that are made with this update:

[list]
[*] Adjusted spawn zones and frequency to limit 'dead-zones'
[*] Adjusted damage values
[*] Quitting game from pause menu no longer holds a freeze on stats updating
[*] Added additional spawn zones to help keep the flow going for activity
[*] Add some more directionality to the airport to help players locate the pilot & aircraft
[*] Fixed volume issues not tracking player adjusted values
[*] Fixed issue where trees visually blocked player
[*] Fixed grass issue where players and enemies were falling through
[*] Added prompts to end game starter NPCs
[*] Added image to show key bindings (Accessible via pause menu in game)
[*] Added a map that can be accessed via the "M" key during gameplay
[*] Adjusted some weapon and equipment details for balance
[/list]

We will continue plugging away at fixes as they come up, and appreciate your patience with us for these early game issues.
